question: How do I get started?
answer: Getting started is easy! Simply sign up for an account, follow our onboarding guide, and you'll be up and running in minutes. Our getting started tutorial will walk you through the essential features and help you set up your first redaction workspace.

question: Can I collaborate with my team?
answer: Yes! Our Starter and Business plans include team collaboration features. You can invite team members, assign roles and permissions, share workspaces, and work together seamlessly on data redaction workflows.

question: What file formats do you support?
answer: We support a wide range of formats including documents (PDF, DOCX), images (PNG, JPG, TIFF), data files (CSV, JSON, XLSX), audio (MP3, WAV), and video (MP4). Our AI-powered redaction works consistently across all supported formats.

question: How accurate is the AI redaction?
answer: Our AI-powered redaction achieves 99.5% accuracy across 50+ entity types including names, SSNs, addresses, medical records, and financial data. The system detects and redacts PII and PHI automatically. All results can be reviewed and adjusted before finalizing.

question: Is my data secure?
answer: Absolutely. We're SOC 2 Type II compliant and use enterprise-grade encryption for data at rest and in transit. Your files are redacted in secure, isolated environments and can be automatically deleted after processing. We never train our AI models on your data.

question: Do you offer a free plan?
answer: Yes! Our Free plan includes 500 credits per month with PDF, DOCX, and image redaction. No credit card required. Upgrade anytime for additional formats, higher credit limits, and advanced features.
